attr.title: Super Mario Sunshine
attr.desc: A native port of Super Mario Sunshine, built from the sms-english decompilation with sms-pc-port's platform code and Starlet.
attr.inst: Copy your own disc image of Super Mario Sunshine (USA, GMSE01) as .iso, .gcm, .rvz or .wia to the sunshine/gamefiles folder, next to the Super Mario Sunshine launcher in your ports folder. The first launch prepares the game files on the device, which takes a few minutes and about 1.1 GB of free space.
